g.title: Def
g.text: belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence:
the people of ancient times, especially neolithic, the Greeks and Romans of classical antiquity:
'we not only have the wisdom of the ancients to draw on,
we also have a sophisticated science and technology capability'
an old man: 'a solitary ancient in a tweed jacket'
Origin: late Middle English: from Old French ancien, based on Latin ante ‘before’.
